evals.expected_output: Creates a conventional, SSH-signed jj commit with a French message and the Automata co-author trailer, without pushing.
evals.prompt: Commit mon changement dans cloud-pi-native/console avec un message conventionnel en français via jj.
assertions: The description starts with 'À utiliser quand'.
The description is at most 200 characters.
The body contains at least one '##' heading.

evals.expected_output: Stages with jj add, commits with jj commit -m honoring the commitlint body-leading-blank rule, then confirms with jj log --pretty=%B.
evals.prompt: Fais un commit conventionnel signé SSH de la correction du lookup de groupe null dans la sync Keycloak.
assertions: The description starts with 'À utiliser quand'.
The description is at most 200 characters.
The body contains at least one '##' heading.

evals.expected_output: Uses the conventional commit shape (type(scope): subject, no trailing period) and appends the Co-authored-by Automata footer.
evals.prompt: Comment committer en conventionnel dans console en respectant le commitlint (body-leading-blank) ?
assertions: The description starts with 'À utiliser quand'.
The description is at most 200 characters.
The body contains at least one '##' heading.
